target.entrypoint_note: AS assembles one translation unit. Include order in src/main.s is ROM order; there is no linker script.

landmarks.role: SEGA screen palette and data boundary
Message-display font-pattern source at asset-bank boundary

dma_alignment.reason: The VDP latches the upper bits of a DMA source address, so a transfer that crosses a block boundary wraps to the start of that block instead of continuing. The cartridge is laid out so that no transferred payload straddles one, and the $FF gaps between regions are part of how that is achieved: they are alignment, not filler.
dma_alignment.exclusion_reason: Compressed art is expanded by the 68000 a byte at a time, not transferred by the VDP, so a block boundary inside it is harmless; three such payloads cross one in the canonical image.
dma_alignment.emulator_note: The vendored Gens increments the ROM DMA source without masking it, so make runtime cannot observe a violation. See docs/runtime.md.

relocation_probe.reason: A reference the assembler owns moves when the layout moves. A value written as a literal does not. Perturbing the layout and requiring every reference to follow is what separates the two, and it needs no emulator.

probes.why: Grows every padding gap by whole DMA blocks, so all content moves while the code keeps its shape and the DMA alignment invariant is preserved.
Inserts unreachable nops inside the code region, so code labels move relative to one another while the org directives hold the content still.

Duplicates every safe rts, which moves each procedure relative to every other one without costing a cycle. A nop would cost four, and four cycles anywhere move the frame counter, which desynchronises a recorded movie on a ROM that plays perfectly by hand. This probe checks the source still assembles that way; the recorded run on the perturbed image is what confirms the behaviour.

return_filler.skip_reason: A short branch inside these stops reaching its target across an inserted word. An rts that is the first entry of a jmp Table(pc,d0.w) branch table is skipped automatically: a return is followed by a label, a table slot by another instruction.

accepted_coincidences.why: Weapon_DirectionVectorsSpeed10 peaks at 10.0 in 16.16, which is the address Sound_PCMBank2 happens to start at.
A dc.l pair whose halves read as one longword; the bytes are a count and a VDP word, not an address.
A nibble-packed data table whose bytes coincide with a PCM bank boundary.
A 12.0 scroll velocity in 16.16, written into work RAM.
The same 12.0 threshold, compared rather than stored.
A byte table whose window coincides with a code label; a pointer is never authored a byte at a time.
A byte table of small offsets whose window coincides with a code label.
A word table of VDP parameters whose window coincides with a code label.
A descending counter table whose window coincides with a code label.

relocation_probe.coincidence_note: A value that equals a symbol address by accident cannot be told from a pointer by its bytes, so each one is listed with why it is a number. A new entry appearing means look at it first.
relocation_probe.ignore_alignment_reason: Symbols on a $8000 boundary are the PCM banks. Their addresses are the same round numbers the ROM uses for VDP commands and 16.16 constants, so a four-byte window matches one by accident constantly, and the banks are referenced as (symbol >> 8), which a 32-bit scan cannot see.
